justification: The helper is Windows-service deployment infrastructure and is intentionally Windows-only.
reviewCondition: Remove when service deployment no longer calls Windows-only APIs or the helper is isolated under platform-specific build configuration.

justification: The UpdateService target manages the local Windows service and intentionally uses Windows-only service APIs.
reviewCondition: Remove when UpdateService is replaced by a cross-platform deployment path or moved behind platform-specific build configuration.

justification: Trusted third-party service deployment is Windows-only operational tooling.
reviewCondition: Remove when trusted-party deployment no longer uses Windows service APIs or is split into a Windows-only build artifact.

justification: Integration-test dependency tooling targets the Windows development host used for MCP Server validation.
reviewCondition: Remove when test dependency setup is made cross-platform or isolated behind platform-specific build configuration.

justification: YamlDotNet models require settable collection properties for TODO YAML deserialization compatibility.
reviewCondition: Remove when TODO YAML models move to a custom immutable deserialization path.

justification: Session log DTO collections are settable to preserve JSON schema compatibility and deserialization behavior.
reviewCondition: Remove when the session log compatibility DTO is retired or deserialization supports immutable collections.

justification: EF Core stores embedding bytes as a nullable BLOB; byte[] is the storage contract rather than a public mutable API.
reviewCondition: Remove when embedding storage changes away from byte[] BLOB persistence or when EF mapping supports a non-array contract.

justification: Windows EventLog setup is guarded by SupportedOSPlatform and only used for Windows service diagnostics.
reviewCondition: Remove when EventLog diagnostics are replaced with a platform-neutral logging provider or platform analysis no longer requires local suppression.
